observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies placed side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a modern design with clear lenses, black housings, and integrated turn signals (orange sections).
The left side of each headlight has a visible amber turn signal and a circular projector lens.
The right side has a rectangular LED daytime running light strip.
The housing appears to be made of black plastic with visible mounting points and electrical connectors.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlights in any photo.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
The seller's text claims 'All models of cars accessories available', but only headlights are shown.
